curated_items.title: How AT&T is building AI-powered legal workflows with OpenAI
curated_items.summary: AT&T’s David McAtee and Bill Ryan describe how AI is changing their legal team’s work—and what they plan to build with OpenAI next. One initiative is a natural-language intake system that would classify and prioritize legal matters, then connect them with relevant knowledge. The aim is to put better information in lawyers’ hands and give them more time for strategy and judgment. Decision-making remains with the lawyers.
